confirmedIssues.title: Absent pack/temperature signals become numeric zero and can certify thermal health
confirmedIssues.mechanism: getLatestSignal distinguishes absent from measured zero, but Get discards the presence booleans for pack and temperatures. Missing signals serialize as 0. With available bricks, there is no no_data status, so temp_spread=0 creates a Normal temperature badge and Thermal balance good recommendation.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only synthetic trace: provide both brick extrema, omit PackVoltage/ModuleTempMin/ModuleTempMax in both live store and StateReader. The handler returns pack/temperatures/spread 0; the ready page formats 0 temperature and asserts thermal balance. No API call or executable reproduction performed.
confirmedIssues.impact: Unknown telemetry is indistinguishable from true zero and can receive healthy labels despite the general caution caption.
confirmedIssues.needs: Narrow integration fix exposing actual signal availability/nullability and consuming it for health predicates, preserving genuine zero and currently reported raw values. Do not guess zero availability in the page.

confirmedIssues.title: A single absent brick extreme still creates an authoritative synthetic pack
confirmedIssues.mechanism: The empty guard requires BOTH extrema absent. An absent maximum retains zero and is combined with a real minimum. Negative spread and an invented average/count/cell sequence are then emitted without partial metadata; any negative imbalance satisfies the page's balanced branch.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only synthetic trace: BrickVoltageMin=3.9, BrickVoltageMax absent, PackVoltage absent. The guard is false, average=1.95, spread=-3900 mV and fallback count=96; generated voltages span 3.9 to 0. The recommendation predicate selects Cells well balanced for the negative spread.
confirmedIssues.impact: Missing source evidence becomes extreme synthetic measurements and contradictory healthy/high-deviation recommendations.
confirmedIssues.needs: Narrow handler/type integration for incomplete extrema, retaining the real value without manufacturing the missing extreme or healthy balance. Native/deployed prevalence NOTRUN.

confirmedIssues.title: Actual extrema overwrites update voltage/delta but leave stale synthetic status
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Status is calculated during interpolation. Subsequent known-index overwrites change Voltage and DeltaFromAvg only. The page faithfully uses the unchanged status for heatmap category, table badge and critical-cell count.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only synthetic trace: min=3.9 V, max=3.94 V, pack=376.32 V gives average=3.92 V and 96 cells. NumBrickVoltageMax=47 overwrites the near-middle, normal cell with 3.94 V and +20 mV; Status remains normal instead of significant_deviation.
confirmedIssues.impact: A displayed significant delta can have a Normal label; critical counts are understated. This is upstream status corruption, not a reason to recompute a competing page classification.
confirmedIssues.needs: One handler-owned fix recomputing the existing >5/>15 mV classification after extrema overwrite, preserving signed deltas, identifiers and thresholds.

confirmedIssues.title: History query failure is rendered as not enough history
confirmedIssues.mechanism: getHistory logs a reader error then returns an empty slice; Get still returns HTTP 200 with the ready snapshot. The client therefore has no error/trust marker and empty history follows the insufficient-history branches.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only trace with successful current readings and BrickVoltageHistory returning an error: response history=[], query success, no fatal/refresh error; all history sections say Not enough history rather than history unavailable.
confirmedIssues.impact: An independent failed source looks authoritatively empty and cannot be retried or explained as a history-source failure.
confirmedIssues.needs: Narrow history availability/error metadata integration; retain the successful current snapshot and expose a nonblocking history-source notice/retry.

confirmedIssues.title: Nullable history aggregates are converted into measured zero
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Each history accumulator starts at float64 zero and remains zero when its pointer is nil. Response history fields are nonnullable numbers, so client knownNumber cannot distinguish missing samples from zero; spread calculations consume the fabricated extrema.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only trace with a history bucket whose MinVoltage/MaxVoltage/AvgMin/AvgMax are nil: output has four zero-derived readings, including 0 mV imbalance. The page plots numeric zero rather than a gap. A one-sided bucket creates a spurious large signed spread.
confirmedIssues.impact: Backend omission defeats the page's otherwise correct null-versus-zero handling and can distort historic balance.
confirmedIssues.needs: One history-shape integration preserving nullable aggregate evidence through typed API fields; keep real zero and chart gaps.

confirmedIssues.title: Initial paused query remains unexplained skeleton loading
confirmedIssues.mechanism: No data/no error/fetchStatus paused derives initial with isRefreshBlocked=true. The page sets loading whenever no data/no fatal error and does not inspect isRefreshBlocked. Its warning returns null without retained data; generic header freshness does not consume fetchStatus.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only state trace with a selected vehicle, data undefined, error null, fetchStatus paused and isFetching false: all data panels stay skeletons with no paused-load explanation. Header refresh may still exist; this report does not claim retry is entirely absent.
confirmedIssues.impact: The operator cannot distinguish a blocked first load from active loading. Existing passing paused case covers retained data only.
confirmedIssues.needs: One page-owned initial-paused explanatory state using existing trust primitives; preserve panel shells, genuine loading, fatal retry and retained paused behavior.

confirmedIssues.title: Annotation fetch failure is silently treated like no saved annotations
confirmedIssues.mechanism: The annotation adapter exposes isLoading/isError/error, but ChartContainer destructures only annotations. Initial failure projects [] and suppresses AnnotationList; a retained refresh failure preserves rows but has no failure notice.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only trace: successful battery query plus failed annotation GET with no cached annotations -> adapter returns annotations=[], isError=true; container displays no annotation warning, indistinguishable from successful empty read. With cached annotations and refresh failure, old markers remain without downgraded trust.
confirmedIssues.impact: An independent source's failure is hidden while the battery chart appears ready. Existing page tests mock annotation reads empty and cannot establish this state.
confirmedIssues.needs: One shared chart-owner task consuming annotation loading/fatal/retained-error trust without erasing the battery series or creating a competing annotation implementation.

confirmedIssues.title: Accessible embedded-chart numeric alternatives bypass locale and scientific precision
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Embedded chart numeric dataColumns omit format/kind. ChartContainer falls through to String(raw), unlike the localized scientific main table/axes and explicitly formatted spread alternative.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only trace with locale fr-FR and voltage 3.9: displayed table/axis uses the locale/scientific formatter; the accessible chart data table receives String(3.9), namely 3.9, rather than the equivalent localized scientific representation. No real locale mount performed.
confirmedIssues.impact: Equivalent chart evidence has inconsistent presentation/precision for nonvisual readers; values are not lost.
confirmedIssues.needs: One page-owned formatting followup supplying existing numeric formatters to the relevant dataColumns while retaining raw chart inputs and all rows.
